There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model for electric vehicles presents a significant strategic challenge. By eliminating traditional dealerships, they reduce overhead costs, allowing for more competitive pricing that could pressure our margins. Furthermore, their direct engagement provides real-time data on consumer preferences and behavior, enabling faster iteration and more targeted marketing. To counter this, we should consider enhancing our own digital sales channels, improving transparency in pricing, and leveraging our existing dealership network for superior customer service and after-sales support, which remains a key differentiator in the automotive sector.
